title: Nvidia and SpaceX Design Star Mind Servers for Space Data Centers

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Jensen Huang revealed that his engineers are collaborating with SpaceX to design hardware that can function in the extreme environment of orbit. The partnership is producing a new server architecture called "Star Mind," which will enter volume production in 2027. These servers are intended to power data centers in space, as well as terrestrial installations, by merging Nvidia's computing technology with SpaceX's infrastructure capabilities.

Elon Musk has increased his GPU orders from thousands to millions and requires 10GW of power by the end of 2027 to manage skyrocketing consumption of Grok Bot. Huang noted that Musk is uniquely positioned to scale these operations because he manages the entire stack, including AI model training, deployment, and the energy systems required for physical buildouts.

selectedTweets.text:
Jensen Huang says he loves working with Elon Musk, and reveals their engineering teams are designing a new type of server to put data centers in space

“I’m delighted that I love working with Elon. He’s using our technology for his own AI in training models and such, deploying models, of course."

"Grok Bot is super cool. The demand for Grok Bot, the consumption for Grok Bot is really skyrocketing. And then, of course, he rents it."

"And so the combination of these three things, he’s fairly unique in doing that. I guess Google does that. That would be yet another example."

"And so I think he also has the advantage that he loves the intersection between computing and the physical buildouts. He loves that whole area. Nobody knows more about energy than he does."

"One particular new market that we’re going to go explore together is putting data centers out in space. Our two engineering teams are working super closely together to create a new type of server, a new type of architecture that might be super good in space and on Earth.”
